dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: When you put it like that...

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: People are always looking for more, but we all have limits on what we can achieve. For most of us, our ambition inevitably outgrows our potential.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: That's why ambition — and desire — are so dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: Imagine you were climbing a summitless mountain — no matter how high you climb, you're eventually going to die on the mountain slopes or plunge to your death down below.

dialogues.speaker: Viljami
dialogues.text: You've got to know when to stop. That's the secret to happiness.
